observations.identity: Stern broad pirate face, strong dark brows, black moustache and braided black beard, scarlet ties, brass-edged tricorn and oxblood coat preserve the accepted project design. Slight facial refinement and larger ornamental hat edging are generated interpretation, not a pixel-identical face. No Seadog substitution.
observations.craftsmanship: Sculpted hair and braid masses, painted worn cloth/leather and controlled brass read as premium miniature bust art. Skin has fine realistic surface texture; physical resin provenance is not claimed.
observations.background: Plain charcoal with a slight tonal gradient, no scenery, lettering, UI, frame or watermark seen. Not numerically uniform.
observations.source_framing: Whole hat corners/crown, scarf ends and beard visible. Outer coat and upper chest terminate at square edges as expected for a bust. Actual upper headroom visually about 4%, less than requested 18%; eye line around 33%, higher than requested 43%. No actual head/headgear clipping; one correction was reserved only for actual clipping or identity failure and was not used.
observations.circular_full100: Centered circle at diameter 100% of square: whole tricorn, face, scarf ends and beard remain inside; lower coat corners, bandolier and pistol hints are partly removed. Crown is close to upper arc, leaving little tolerance for a tighter future crop or border. Keep full100; no zoom.
observations.native_80: Hat, beard, coat and face remain recognizable; braid ties are color accents and individual eyes are small.
observations.native_40: Broad pirate silhouette and facial light/dark read; precise eye color, small brass details and individual braids do not reliably resolve. Not proof of character identity to an unfamiliar viewer.
